answers.moment: When we got onto gardening. I'd just been telling him about my tomatoes finally going red (I'd sent a photo to my mum that morning) and it turned out he grows chillies & coriander in pots on his patio in Hayes, which I really didn't expect. He seemed quite shy at the start, but when it was about the plants he seemed a bit more relaxed and happy. I remember thinking we're both people who get stupidly excited about a few pots  in a small garden :)
answers.reason: It was the first proper thing we had in common, so the conversation stopped feeling like small talk. Also it just made me smile.
